title: scene/<period_id>.json: site-independent Sun/Earth geometry for the 3D globe (OPTIONAL file)
description: Parallel arrays, one entry per time step. Sub-solar point = where the Sun is at zenith (drives the terminator); sub-Earth point = where the Earth is at zenith. MOON_ME frame, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon.

subsolar_lat_deg.description: planetocentric latitude of the sub-solar point (deg)

subsolar_lon_deg.description: east longitude of the sub-solar point, -180..180 (deg)

subearth_lat_deg.description: planetocentric latitude of the sub-Earth point (deg)

subearth_lon_deg.description: east longitude of the sub-Earth point, -180..180 (deg)

earth_phase_frac.description: illuminated fraction of the Earth disk seen from the Moon's centre

sun_ra_deg.description: OPTIONAL: right ascension of the Sun seen from the Moon's centre, J2000 (ICRF) axes, LT+S, deg

sun_dec_deg.description: OPTIONAL: declination of the Sun seen from the Moon's centre, J2000 (ICRF) axes, LT+S, deg

earth_ra_deg.description: OPTIONAL: right ascension of the Earth seen from the Moon's centre, J2000 (ICRF) axes, LT+S, deg

earth_dec_deg.description: OPTIONAL: declination of the Earth seen from the Moon's centre, J2000 (ICRF) axes, LT+S, deg
